archive_quota_rule: Hamilton rounding of original v3 train16000 module-count proportions to 25000
historical_drop_policy: Recompute every historically rejected member before dispatching unseen members, including drops with old saved layouts
retention: Save every returned layout regardless of Q or legality; store source, derived input areas, scoring, execution provenance. Never delete on teacher threshold changes
target_semantics: 25000 distinct members with durable layouts, including imported accepted members and recomputed historical drops. Retries are separate attempted work, never additional distinct samples
selection: Among hard-legal archived members at/below chosen Q, sort by (Q,candidate id) in each stratum and take up to teacher quota; report shortages at 25000 without silently expanding target
